Container.Name: Stellarr
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted text, voice and video chat for a group of friends. One container runs the web client, the API, object storage, a TURN server and the media server that carries every call.
Open the Web UI and create the first account: it becomes the instance owner and gets a server of its own. Later accounts join through invite links. The owner's panel, Cockpit, is at /cockpit/.
On first start the container creates a self-signed certificate, so the browser shows a warning once. For a trusted certificate or a reverse proxy, see the documentation.
Container.Requires: Voice from any device other than the Unraid server itself needs PUBLIC_IP. Calls from outside your network also need UDP port 49000 forwarded from the router to this server on the same external port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, uploads, encryption keys, generated secrets and TLS certificates. Keep it on a pool (cache) drive and back up the whole folder.

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: The web client and Cockpit. Set PUBLIC_HTTPS_PORT below to the same number.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Redirects to HTTPS.

Config.Name: Voice media port
Config.Description: Every call goes through this port. Set Rtc__MediaPort below to the same number, and forward the same external port on the router for calls from outside your network.

Config.Name: TURN port (UDP)
Config.Description: TURN for browsers that cannot reach the voice media port directly. Set Rtc__TurnPort below to the same number.

Config.Name: TURN relay ports
Config.Description: Ports TURN relays calls through. Keep the host range the same as the container range.

Config.Name: TURN port (TCP)
Config.Description: Used only when Rtc__TurnTcpEnabled is true.

Config.Name: TURNS port (TCP)
Config.Description: TURN over TLS, used only when Rtc__TurnsEnabled is true. Set Rtc__TurnsPort to the same number.

Config.Name: TURNS port (UDP)
Config.Description: TURN over DTLS, used only when Rtc__TurnsEnabled is true.

Config.Name: Domain
Config.Description: The name or IPv4 address people open Stellarr at, for example chat.example.com or 192.168.1.10. The certificate and TURN use it. Empty means localhost, which only the Unraid server itself can use.

Config.Name: Public IP
Config.Description: The IPv4 address browsers reach this server at: its LAN address for calls at home, your public address for calls over the internet, or auto to resolve the domain. Empty means voice works only through TURN.

Config.Name: HTTPS host port
Config.Description: The host side of the HTTPS port mapping above. The redirect from HTTP and the instance's public address use it.

Config.Name: Voice media host port
Config.Description: The host side of the voice media port mapping above. The media server tells browsers this port.

Config.Name: Interface language
Config.Description: en or pl. The web client's default language. Set Server language to the same value.

Config.Name: Server language
Config.Description: en or pl. The language of server messages, mail and the names of a new server's roles and channels.

Config.Name: Instance name
Config.Description: The name desktop clients show for this instance.

Config.Name: Public HTTPS port
Config.Description: The HTTPS port browsers use, when it differs from the host port: 443 behind a reverse proxy. Empty means PUBLIC_HTTPS_PORT.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The full address for mail links and desktop clients, for example https://chat.example.com. Overrides the address built from the domain and port.

Config.Name: TURN host port
Config.Description: The host side of the TURN port mappings.

Config.Name: TURNS host port
Config.Description: The host side of the TURNS port mappings.

Config.Name: TURN over TCP
Config.Description: true or false.

Config.Name: TURN over TLS
Config.Description: true or false. Needs a certificate browsers trust.

Config.Name: GIPHY key
Config.Description: Public GIPHY web key for GIF search. It can also be set in Cockpit under Integrations, which wins over this one.

Config.Name: Mail
Config.Description: true or false. The SMTP server, port and login are set in Cockpit.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Can also be set in Cockpit, which wins over this one.

Config.Name: Resend API key
Config.Description: Replaces SMTP when Resend is turned on in Cockpit under Integrations.

Config.Name: OIDC sign-in
Config.Description: true or false. Sign-in through an identity provider such as Pocket ID. Password sign-in stays available.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: For example https://auth.example.com

Config.Name: OIDC button label
Config.Description: The label of the sign-in button.

Config.Name: Trust the provider's second step
Config.Description: true or false. When true, a sign-in the provider confirmed with a second step counts as Stellarr's own.

Config.Name: Provider second-step amr values
Config.Description: The amr values that count as a second step when the setting above is true.

Config.Name: Minimum free space (bytes)
Config.Description: Uploads are refused when the data folder has less free space than this.

Config.Name: Database command log level
Config.Description: Information logs every SQL statement.
